Name: Simple Hoarder Chest
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]📦 Simple Hoarder Chest 📦[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]PC · Stardew Valley 1.6.15 · [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.1+[/url] · 12 languages[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]An upgradeable chest with automatic categories, custom tabs, item search and crafting from stored ingredients.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Storage & Upgrades[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Main Chest[/b] shows all stored items. Category compartments sort materials, farming, fishing, foraging, minerals, food, equipment and miscellaneous items. Add up to [b]24 custom tabs[/b], hide or restore tabs, or delete empty custom tabs.

Start with [b]120 regular slots[/b]. Each H kit adds 120; upgrade to [b]1,200[/b] by default, or enable a ceiling of [b]9,960[/b]. Category/custom compartments have a per-matching-item limit of [b]9,999[/b], with [b]999[/b] and [b]Unlimited[/b] options.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]🛠 Get the Chest & H Kits[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Read Robin’s introduction letter, then buy the [b]25,000g recipe[/b] at her normal shop. It teaches both the Hoarder Chest and H upgrade kit.

[b]Both recipes:[/b] 1 empty regular Chest · 200 Wood · 15 Hardwood · 10 Iron Bars · 5 Gold Bars. Occupied, special, favourite and protected chests cannot be used as ingredients.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]⚠ H kits upgrade only Hoarder Chests[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Select an H kit in your hotbar, right-click a [b]placed Hoarder Chest[/b], then confirm. Each kit adds 120 regular slots. H kits cannot upgrade ordinary chests.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🔄 Transfers & Stacking[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Left-click[/b] withdraws up to 999 available items; [b]right-click[/b] withdraws one. There is currently no half-stack withdrawal shortcut. Use Deposit Matching for matching backpack items, and Organize to combine compatible partial stacks within a compartment.

[b]Version 1.39[/b] fixes reproduced stacking mismatches caused by transient display state and historical ownership on plain, empty placeable items. Different quality, colour, custom item data and protected items remain separate.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌐 Crafting & Optional Integrations[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Craft using backpack and stored ingredients, with favourite/protected ingredients respected. [b]Better Crafting[/b] can use ingredients across SHC compartments.

[b]Chests Anywhere:[/b] open SHC remotely within its configured range and ignored-chest rules. Use [b]Cog → Choose a chest[/b] to switch eligible chests. The optional [b]Global remote access[/b] override allows access across locations.

[b]Lookup Anything[/b] can include SHC compartments in owned-item and gift counts. Optional integrations also support Convenient Inventory, MH Tool Pouch Extended and Market Town. Item Lock and Simple Pouch protections can be toggled on backpack items; stored entries show their indicators.

Use the chest cog for settings, or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]📥 Installation & Removal[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Extract [b]SimpleHoardChest[/b] into Mods, replacing the previous version. Keep the same version installed for all multiplayer players. Empty every compartment through Main before removing the mod.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🐛 Bug Reports & Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Include the mod version, affected item and quality, and a fresh [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]. For stacking issues, keep two affected stacks separate in your backpack, select one in the toolbar, and run [b]shc_stack_info[/b] in the SMAPI console. Open or stand beside the Hoarder Chest to include stored items. This command only reads item information. Suggestions are welcome in Posts.[/color][/size][/center]
